scopeBasis: Bounded re-evaluation of at most five ownership-class holds nominated as NEXT OPUS BATCH in the Wave22 handoff. No new candidate discovery.
policyBasis: docs/VENUE_DATA_GUIDE.md as it now stands. The production gate is a complete, losslessly structured printed numbered set for the declared representative scope, with no invented seat IDs, no capacity fitting, no unsupported deletion and no invented block ownership. A printed-versus-published difference, a non-zero rangeDiff, an unresolved wheelchair substitution, non-fixed seating and the existence of multiple configurations are confidence metadata, not blockers. The Wave21 display-area policy was available; neither promoted venue needed it, and it was found inapplicable to the one venue re-held.

venues.venue: 国立音楽大学〔講堂大ホール〕
venues.priorBlockerResolution: The Wave13 hold said the segmented number groups had no issuer-defined row/area ownership. The chart in fact prints a kana row label on the inner edge of every block — four label columns at x≈149, 249, 348 and 447 — so the outermost, side and centre blocks are each issuer-named and no geometric inference is required. The label columns also explain the block shapes: the outermost blocks carry rows い〜ち and に〜へ (24 labels each) while the side and centre blocks carry あ〜ふ (28 labels), which is exactly why row あ has no outermost seats and row へ has only outermost seats.
venues.structureNote: One numbering axis 1-46 per row across five blocks (1-5 / 6-17 / 18-29 / 30-41 / 42-46), rows あ〜ふ plus the rear block rows ほ and ま numbered 1-24. Block totals 117 + 336 + 336 + 336 + 117 + 48 = 1,290.

venues.dataCorrection: The Tokyo metropolitan list records the municipality as 武蔵村山市; the issuer's own access page states 東京都立川市柏町5-5-1, so the production source uses 立川市. The inventory row is left as the discovery-list record and the discrepancy is disclosed in the configuration metadata.

venues.venue: 武蔵野市民文化会館〔大ホール〕
venues.priorBlockerResolution: The B_SOURCE_LIMITED hold rested on the printed-versus-published difference and on the separate technical seating plan omitting seat-number mappings. The seat chart alone is sufficient. Every block carries a printed row label, and the transcription reproduces the chart's own footnote 固定席1,252席（1階912席 2階340席）exactly: 1F rows 1-25 give 912 and 2F rows 26-43 give 340. The remaining difference against the published 1,256 is precisely the four unnumbered 車椅子席 the same footnote lists separately.
venues.structureNote: 1階席 rows 1-25 over five blocks (1-5 / 6-15 / 16-26 / 27-36 / 37-41). 2階席 splits into the wall-side rows 26-36 (left seats 1-5, right seats 45-49) and the rear balcony rows 37-43. The floor attribution of rows 26-36 is fixed by the issuer's own arithmetic — 254 rear-balcony seats plus these 86 give exactly the published 340 — not by drawing position.

venues.venue: 足立区文化芸術劇場 シアター1010〔劇場〕
venues.remainingBlocker: The current chart prints its row labels in a single column, immediately to the left of the centre block; the right-hand blocks carry no row label at all. The numbering axis continues across the centre into the right block (for example row 1 runs 5-8, 9-16, 18-21), so those seats are part of the main row rather than an independently numbered side block, which means the Wave21 display-area policy cannot represent them either. Assigning them to an adjacent row from drawing position alone is prohibited.
venues.nextEvidence: Either issuer material that labels the right-hand blocks, or a demonstration that the published 1階553席 / 2階148席 subtotals admit exactly one assignment of the unlabelled right-hand block lines to rows. The latter was not attempted in this wave.

The recorded source set still contains only a facility page and no official numbered seat map, despite a blocking reason that refers to one.
venues.nextEvidence: Locate and register an official numbered seat map before any further evaluation; the recorded blocker cannot be tested against the sources currently registered.

methodNote: The decisive test in this wave was whether the issuer prints a row label beside each block. Where it does (国立音楽大学, 武蔵野), block ownership is issuer-defined and the transcription reconciles with the issuer's own totals. Where it does not (シアター1010), the hold stands. This is a cheaper and more reliable discriminator than the rake-offset reconstruction used in Wave22 for 人見記念講堂, and should be tried first on any remaining ownership-class hold.
